body:
# Eternal Furnace

Gives Netherrack a new purpose — craft Hellfire Netherrack, place it under a Furnace, and burn forever. No more hauling coal. The catch: eternal fuel smelts slower than the real thing.

## How it works

Combine **Flint and Steel + Netherrack** to craft **Hellfire Netherrack**. Place that block directly beneath a regular Furnace, and the furnace runs on infinite fuel — no need to feed the fuel slot at all. The trade-off is speed: each item takes 1.8x longer than normal.

| | Normal Furnace | Eternal Furnace |
|---|---|---|
| Fuel | Consumes fuel | Infinite, no fuel needed |
| Speed | ~10s per item | ~18s per item |

Set up a stack of ore, walk away, and let it cook through the night.

## Features

- New block: **Hellfire Netherrack**, a darker, smoldering variant of Netherrack
- Simple recipe — Flint and Steel + Netherrack (the Flint and Steel is consumed)
- Infinite fuel when placed under a Furnace, balanced by 1.8x slower smelting
- Works only on the regular Furnace — Blast Furnaces and Smokers are untouched, keeping their role as the fast option
- Remove the block and the furnace reverts to normal vanilla behavior

## Installation

1. Install [Minecraft Forge](https://files.minecraftforge.net/) for 1.20.1
2. Download the latest `.jar` from the Versions tab
3. Place it in your `mods/` folder
4. Launch the game and enjoy!

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.20.1
- Forge
